Name: A Small Maru Expansion
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]A small mod that I created for some future mods I have planned. This mod plays Maru's 10-heart event once you reach 8-hearts with her, and replaces it with a new 10-heart event. This heart event requires you to have seen the MarILDA cutscene and is triggered by entering the mountain between 9 and 4.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Huge thanks to the Stardew Valley discord with brainstorming dialogue![/size][/color]
